query_text: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

messages.content: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

message.content:
In **Massachusetts**, the **maximum weekly unemployment benefit** is **$1,105 per week**, and you can receive it for up to **30 weeks** if you qualify.[2][4]

A few important details:

- Your actual weekly amount is usually about **50% of your average weekly wage**, up to that cap.[4]
- Over a full 30-week benefit period, the **maximum total** would be **$33,150** before any dependent allowances, if you qualified for the full maximum each week.[2][4]
- Massachusetts also says your benefit year can allow up to **30 times your weekly benefit amount** or **36% of your total base-period wages**, whichever applies under the rules.[4]

If you want, I can also help you estimate **your own weekly benefit amount** based on your wages.
